_about: Gate check 0 (Ruling, Krish, 2026-10-23): for a text-match trial, a dated sample of up to 50 matched items is reviewed; at least 80% must be about fractional or interim executive work, and no single publisher may supply more than half (waived where the query is confined to one site by design). Samples come from supabase/functions/collect-trials ?diagnose=relevance, ?diagnose=guardian and ?diagnose=podchaser. A review older than 60 days no longer passes. Reviewed items are listed in the commit that records each review.

reviews.notes: All four role terms, past week. Vendor, rate-guide and job-listing pages about fractional roles; one borderline item is a company profile for a firm named Fractional CTO.
